svg.title: Just One More Moment
svg.desc: My wiring for Just One More Moment, by Simon Balmer. Connection view grouped by component; separate physical 40-pin J8 locator. Display P2/P6 plus DSI; button COM P9, NO P11 GPIO17, LED+ P13 GPIO27, LED- P14. SW01 P15 GPIO22/P20 GND; SW02 P16 GPIO23/P25 GND. 11 NeoPixels: P4 through MIC 1N4001 to +V, cathode ring toward strip; P19 GPIO10 directly to DIN; P34 to GND. Webcam USB; official PSU USB-C.

g.aria-label: Connections grouped by component. Physical J8 pin positions: locator below.
TOP VIEW / USB PORTS AT RIGHT
P1 = lower left. Red pins are used in my wiring.
I lower the strip supply with D1 so it can
SW01 and SW02 are software inputs.
SW01 does not switch the USB camera cable.
I disconnect power before changing wires.
Component and port positions in the main view are grouped for clarity.
